# SearchWin.ai

> SearchWin.ai is an organic growth agency for the AI search era. We get businesses recommended by ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Microsoft Copilot and Google's AI Overviews and AI Mode, then turn AI-referred visitors into calls, bookings, leads and sales.

Key facts:

- Who we work with: any business where people ask AI what to buy or who to hire. Typical segments: SaaS, B2B (manufacturing, logistics, industrial, IT and professional services), e-commerce, local businesses and services, clinics and healthcare, finance and fintech, real estate and travel. SaaS and B2B have dedicated pages.
- What makes us different: most AI visibility agencies report mentions and share of voice. We report AI-sourced leads, calls, bookings, sales and revenue, and our scope includes landing pages and conversion optimization (CRO) for AI-referred traffic.
- How it works: 1) Get understood (crawl access, structured data, consistent entity facts), 2) Get cited (comparison, "best for", service, product and location pages built around real customer questions), 3) Get recommended (reviews, roundups, communities, media), 4) Get chosen (CRO for AI traffic, online booking, short forms, attribution to revenue).
- Methodology, six practices focused on organic leads and sales: conversion-first architecture; AI search optimization for ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI; SEO 2.0 and entity optimization (knowledge graph, Google rankings and Google Maps); digital PR and machine trust; crowd marketing on Reddit and Quora; social SEO and content indexing on LinkedIn, X, YouTube and Instagram.
- How an engagement starts: a free AI visibility report and roadmap. We test 100+ customer questions across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google's AI, map where competitors win, find conversion leaks on pages AI sends people to, and deliver a 90-day roadmap ranked by revenue impact. Delivered within 5 business days.
- Measurement: GA4 referral and landing page data, source fields in the CRM or store, and self-reported attribution, re-run monthly on a fixed set of questions.
- Platforms covered: ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and AI Mode, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, Grok, DeepSeek, Meta AI.
- Contact: hi@searchwin.ai
